name: hooks-git-workflow
description: Opt-in git workflow hooks: BLOCK a git push when unit tests are stale or failing (the hook does not run tests — it reads the edit/test state the tracker records and tells the agent to run them; warns-and-allows when no test command is detectable, bypass with SKIP_TEST_GATE=1), track edit-vs-test state from real test runners only, and warn about uncommitted AND unpushed work at session end (continuous commit/push cadence). Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).
